transcript: On the first day of every month, blow cinnamon at the entrance of your home to attract abundance and money. Take a little ground cinnamon in the palm of your right hand, walk to your front door and stand facing inward, say silently, when this cinnamon blows, prosperity will enter. When this cinnamon blows, abundance will come to stay. When this cinnamon blows, wealth will live here. Cinnamon blow the cinnamon into your home with full intention. Do not blow in a hurry, feel what you are doing. Intention is what activates the ritual. Do not sweep for 24 hours, let the cinnamon settle. During those 24 hours, the cinnamon works in silence, cleansing the energy of scarcity and opening the way for prosperity. Intention is one of the spices most associated with abundance across all ancient traditions. Its vibration activates the movement of money. In our monastery we have used it for generations to cleanse spaces and open pathways. The next day you can sweep normally what was meant to stay has already stayed. Do it on the first day of every month to keep the cycle active. Write in the comments, it is done to seal your intention. But I want you to understand something. Cinnamon moves the energy of the space. But if fear of money still lives inside you, anxiety every time you check your accounts and a scarcity mindset you have been carrying for years, the abundance that enters leaves just as fast as it arrived. Money does not flow toward fear, it flows toward calm. Cycles open the door, but what makes prosperity stay is what happens inside you and if you want to release the fear that is blocking your abundance and live from a place of calm where money flows without forcing. I have spent more than 20 years learning in silence how to do that and everything I know is inside the way back to calm. The link is in my profile.
